Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor

Class EditorDocument

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor.EditorDocument
public class EditorDocument extends Object
The image editor's document model: a fixed-size canvas and an ordered stack of ImageLayers (index 0 is the bottom). It composites the visible layers to a single image for display and export, and manages the active layer and layer reordering. The class is pure AWT (no Swing, no Java 3D), so it builds and is asserted on headless.
